doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: Piron, the violinist and Steve Lewis at the Pelican
summary: Neighbours Piron and the Mexican-looking violinist come up, then Billie recalls playing with Steve Lewis at the Pelican.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Put my Piro. Piro and the violin player. Mm-hmm.
Sort of Mexican looking fella.
He's out of Texas.
He's almost Texas.
I was with Piro and at the Olapson House.
And Piro and the man guys?
Piro and Miss Piro.
You used to live on my house?
Yeah, yeah. Yeah, yeah.
Piro and Miss Piro and like the other one. Yeah, I know.
All right, yeah, sure. Yeah, sure.
What was that? Miss Piro lives near here? Yeah, right on the corner there. Oh, yeah. That must have been who Doc Sushan was gonna see.
No, across the street. Oh, across the street. Across the street to uh, Cascine. Cascine, yeah. Cascine, yeah.

I don't know Doc, you know. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Piro and Will. Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. And Steve Lewis. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Steve Lewis piano player. I took a violin lesson out of Piro. You took a violin lesson? Yeah, I was 10 years old when I first started.

Steve Lewis and I used to call him up his uh, up over, let's see, at the Pelican, at the Pelican, Pelican up on Rand Paul Street. He had a, you know, saloon up there and thing like that. We used to go up there and play piano. We used to have some fun, me, Steve Lewis.
Two on one piano or two pianos?
No, that's me. He played something and get him out and sit down and play, you know, like that.
What did Steve feature?

Let me see. What? He had a feature. I'm telling you the truth. I just remember now with that boy. I don't know what. What did he used to play and sing? I don't know what it. I really forgot it. I've been so long. I really forgot it, Steve. What did he?
He sang some Smutty songs, didn't he?

Yeah, I know. I will tell you that while he's up there. He's up there. He's singing Smutty and I'll sing Smutty to Boba. While we have some fun up there. I'll tell you that I'll play the fun up there. stuff
